question: Who inaugurated the Namchik Namphuk Coal Mine in Arunachal Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**G. Kishan Reddy.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **G. Kishan Reddy__, Union Minister for Coal and Mines, along with __Pema Khandu__, Arunachal Pradesh Chief Minister, inaugurated the __Namchik Namphuk Coal Mine__ in Changlang District, Arunachal Pradesh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Namchik Namphuk Coal Mine__ in Arunachal Pradesh has a coal reserve capacity of __1.5 crore tonnes__.**
 
• **This mine is a significant step toward energy security and development in __North East India__.**
 
• **The project is expected to generate substantial __employment opportunities__ for the youth of Arunachal Pradesh.**
 
• **The mine is set to bring __Rs 100 crore__ annual revenue to the state of Arunachal Pradesh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Namchik Namphuk Coal Mine**__

 __
 
• The mine is operational from October 2025__ and is expected to significantly contribute to __India's energy security__.
 
• The project is a part of the __Government of India’s focus__ on improving infrastructure in the North East region.
 
 
 
• __**India’s Coal Sector**__
 __
 
• India is the second-largest producer__ and consumer of coal in the world and holds the __fifth-largest coal reserve__.
 
• Coal remains crucial for __India's energy development__ and plays a key role in the nation’s future growth.
 
 
 
• __**Arunachal Pradesh's Role**__
 __
 
• The Namchik Namphuk Coal Mine__ is expected to contribute significantly to __Arunachal Pradesh’s economy__ and create sustainable job opportunities.
